title: Automotive Education and Experience
text:
[Education: Automotive Technology]
I was involved in the automotive program at Rio Hondo Community College for two years, ranging from several classes that involved hands-on work on various vehicles. These classes ranged from different subjects from engine repairs, smog, electrical diagnostics, and brakes. Provided below are several of the classes that I partook in to better understand vehicles and how to address issues and maintenance services.
Classes Taken:

AUTO 101: Introduction Automotive Service & Repair Under the Hood: Introductory class to general automotive services for components primarily focused within the engine bay.
AUTO 103: Introduction Automotive Service & Repair Under Car : Introductory class that mainly focuses on the whole chassis (drivetrain, tranmission, suspension components)
AUTO 106: Automotive Electrical Tool & Diagnostics The understanding of eletrical components including wiring harnesses, lights, fuses, modules, etc on a vehicle.
AUTO 107: Introduction to Automotive Light Service A followup on the underhood and undercar services of a vehicle, including battery and basic electrical service, pre-delivery inspection procedures, and preventative maintenance operations.
